meta.name: baoyu-format-markdown
meta.description: Formats plain text or markdown files with frontmatter, titles, summaries, headings, bold, lists, and code blocks. Use when user asks to "format markdown", "beautify article", "add formatting", or improve article layout. Outputs to {filename}-formatted.md.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给纯文本或 Markdown 文件添加标题、摘要、加粗等格式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速美化文章或笔记的排版
copy.tagline_en: Add titles, summaries, bold, and more to plain text or Markdown files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly beautify the layout of articles or notes

howto.what: 把纯文本或 Markdown 整理成结构化 Markdown:补全标题和摘要,加各级标题、加粗、列表、代码块,并调整中文/英文间距;若是 Markdown 会先询问处理方式。另存为「原文件名-formatted.md」。
howto.when: 当你说「格式化 Markdown」「美化文章」等,或要求改善文章排版并给出文本/Markdown 文件时触发。

say.text: 把这份纯文本格式化成 Markdown。
美化这篇文章的排版,保留原有结构。
say.note: 会先问你要优化、保留原样还是只修排版。

say.text: 修一下这篇文档的中文英文间距。
say.note: 会运行排版脚本调整间距,不改其他内容。

howto.what_en: Claude converts text or Markdown into structured Markdown: adds frontmatter (title, summary), headings, bold, lists, code blocks, and CJK/English spacing. If input is Markdown, asks user's preference. Saves to {filename}-formatted.md.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to 'format markdown', 'beautify an article', 'add formatting', or improve article layout.

say_en.text: Format this plain text into Markdown.
say_en.note: Creates a -formatted.md file with title, summary, and lists.

say_en.text: Beautify this article's layout, keeping its structure.
say_en.note: Asks whether to optimize, preserve, or fix typography only.

say_en.text: Fix the CJK/English spacing in this document.
say_en.note: Runs the typography script without other changes.
